Enabling this feature will allow Dell to access your Chrome device telemetry data. You will be subject to your separate agreement with Dell regarding the use of this data. At any time during the term of your license you can disable this feature by following the instructions in the https://support.google.com/chrome/a/answer/9408918 help center article linked. Please note that for uninterrupted telemetry data collection we recommend that you also restrict sign-ins to only users in your domain and turn off guest mode.
